pairs.target: lán xiù de dìèr fēngxìn dào shí , tǎ wéi zhèngzài bǎ chuángbǎn xiàmiàn de xié wǎng wài tāo .
pairs.english: When Lanxiu's second letter arrived, Tavi was fishing shoes out from under his bed.
pairs.hanzi: 岚绣的第二封信到时，塔维正在把床板下面的鞋往外掏。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi lái qiāomén de shì pà wò , tóu yě méi tái , shuō zuǒbiān nà zhī búshì zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: Thinking Pavo was knocking, he said without looking up that the left shoe was not his.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为来敲门的是帕沃，头也没抬，说左边那只不是自己的。

pairs.target: sòngxìn de rén xiào le yìshēng , bǎ xìn fàngzài ménbiān de xiǎo zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: The messenger laughed and put the letter on the little table by the door.
pairs.hanzi: 送信的人笑了一声，把信放在门边的小桌上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chōuchū shǒu , zhǐjié cèng pò le yìdiǎn , gùbúshàng kàn , xiān rènchū le fēngmiàn shàng jǐ dé hěn jǐn de zì .
pairs.english: Tavi pulled out his hand, scraping a knuckle slightly. Before he could look at it, he recognized the cramped writing on the envelope.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抽出手，指节蹭破了一点，顾不上看，先认出了封面上挤得很紧的字。

pairs.target: lán xiù yào lái wěi jiē .
pairs.english: Lanxiu was coming to ReedSteps.
pairs.hanzi: 岚绣要来苇阶。

pairs.target: tā bǎ rìzi xiě le liǎngbiàn , shuō bàngè yuè hòu dào , zài lín yuán tì tā liúhuà de yánpù hòu wū zhù liǎnggè wǎnshàng .
pairs.english: She wrote the date twice: she would arrive in half a month and stay two nights in the back room of the salt shop where Lin Yuan left messages for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她把日子写了两遍，说半个月后到，在林沅替她留话的盐铺后屋住两个晚上。

pairs.target: ruò tǎ wéi láidejí , tā huì děng tā ; ruò láibùjí , réng kěyǐ xiěxìn , búbì wèile jiàn tā zǒu yèlù .
pairs.english: If Tavi could make it, she would wait for him; otherwise he could still write. He need not travel at night to see her.
pairs.hanzi: 若塔维来得及，她会等他；若来不及，仍可以写信，不必为了见她走夜路。

pairs.target: suíchē de rén yǒu jǐgè , tā méi néng wèn zhǔn .
pairs.english: She had not established how many people accompanied the wagons.
pairs.hanzi: 随车的人有几个，她没能问准。

pairs.target: yǒurén jìde sìgè , yǒurén shuō zhōngtú yòu shàng le rén .
pairs.english: Someone remembered four; someone else said others had joined along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 有人记得四个，有人说中途又上了人。

pairs.target: zhìyú wū yà , tā tuōrén wèn le jiù gōngpéng , hái mòshōu dào huíhuà .
pairs.english: As for Wuya, she had sent an inquiry to the old workshops but had not yet heard back.
pairs.hanzi: 至于乌娅，她托人问了旧工棚，还没收到回话。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ méiyǒu bǎ nàge háizi jiàozuò tǎ wéi , zhī shuō , xīwàng néng dāngmiàn bǎ zìjǐ jìde de shìqíng jiǎng gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: The letter did not call that child Tavi; it only said she hoped to tell him in person what she remembered.
pairs.hanzi: 信里没有把那个孩子叫作塔维，只说，希望能当面把自己记得的事情讲给他听。

pairs.target: tā jiāng xìn cóngtóu dú dào wěi , yòu huíqù kàn rìzi .
pairs.english: He read the letter from beginning to end, then returned to the date.
pairs.hanzi: 他将信从头读到尾，又回去看日子。

pairs.target: wūlǐ hěn ānjìng , chuángdǐ de huī zhān zài tā shǒu bèishàng , liúxià jǐdào hēi yìn .
pairs.english: The room was quiet. Dust from beneath the bed left black streaks on the back of his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里很安静，床底的灰沾在他手背上，留下几道黑印。

pairs.target: zhècì búshì wèn yìfēngxìn shénme shíhòu huì dào . tā kěyǐ qù jiàn yígè rén .
pairs.english: This time he was not asking when a letter would arrive. He could go and meet a person.
pairs.hanzi: 这次不是问一封信什么时候会到。他可以去见一个人。

pairs.target: yīwén huílái ná shū , kànjiàn tǎ wéi dūn zài chuángbiān , wèn xié shìbushì diào dào lóuxià qù le .
pairs.english: Iven came back for a book and, seeing Tavi crouched by the bed, asked whether the shoes had fallen downstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文回来拿书，看见塔维蹲在床边，问鞋是不是掉到楼下去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn qǐlái , jiāng xìn dìgěi tā . yīwén dúwán , xiān bǎ zhuōshàng de shuǐbēi nuó yuǎn , cái tānkāi zìjǐ de lù tú . "
pairs.english: Tavi stood and gave him the letter. After reading it, Iven first moved the water cup away before spreading out his route map.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维站起来，将信递给他。伊文读完，先把桌上的水杯挪远，才摊开自己的路图。
“

pairs.target: wǒ zhǐnéng bāng nǐ zhǎodào mǎtóu . " tā shuō , " chuánqī dé qù wèn . "
pairs.english: “I can only help you find the landing,” he said. “You'll have to ask about sailing times.”
pairs.hanzi: 我只能帮你找到码头。”他说，“船期得去问。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zài tú shàng zhǎo wěi jiē . tā bú xiàng tǎ wéi qǐxiān yǐwéi de nàme yuǎn :
pairs.english: They found ReedSteps on the map. It was not as far as Tavi had first thought:
pairs.hanzi: 两个人在图上找苇阶。它不像塔维起先以为的那么远：

pairs.target: xiān xiàshān dào píng mǎtóu , zài zuò suí bān de kèhuòchuán , búbì jīngguò zǎoyǐ gǎidào de jiù héàn .
pairs.english: First down the mountain to Flat Landing, then a regular passenger-and-freight boat, without needing the old riverbank route that had long been diverted.
pairs.hanzi: 先下山到平码头，再坐随班的客货船，不必经过早已改道的旧河岸。

pairs.target: dàn qù chéng shùnliú , huíchéng què bùnéng zhào tóngyàng de shíchén suàn .
pairs.english: But the outward trip went downstream; the return could not be reckoned by the same hours.
pairs.hanzi: 但去程顺流，回程却不能照同样的时辰算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐjīng bǎ liǎngtiān xiě jìn běnzi , tīng wán yòu huàdiào .
pairs.english: Tavi had already written two days in his notebook and now crossed it out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维已经把两天写进本子，听完又划掉。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu tì tā tián shàng lìng yígè shù , péi tā bǎ yào wèn de dìfāng quānqǐlái .
pairs.english: Iven did not fill in another number for him, but helped circle what he needed to ask.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有替他填上另一个数，陪他把要问的地方圈起来。

pairs.target: jiēxiàlái de sāntiān , tā qù wèn le chuán xíng , yě zhǎo le wéi lǎoshī hé nài lěi .
pairs.english: Over the next three days, he visited the boat company and spoke with Vey and Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 接下来的三天，他去问了船行，也找了维老师和奈蕾。

pairs.target: chuán xíng gěi de shì yuèdǐ jíshì nà bān de rìzi : tíqián liǎngtiān lí chéng , dìèrtiān bàngwǎn dào wěi jiē .
pairs.english: The boat company gave him the end-of-month market sailing: leave the city two days ahead and reach ReedSteps the following evening.
pairs.hanzi: 船行给的是月底集市那班的日子：提前两天离城，第二天傍晚到苇阶。

pairs.target: jiànmiàn hòu de cìrì yǒu huí chuán , shàngxíng màn , háiyào duō liú yìtiān , yù shuǐwèi biànhuà zé tīng mǎtóu de ānpái .
pairs.english: A return boat left the day after the meeting. Upstream was slower, so he needed an extra day; if water levels changed, he should follow the landing's arrangements.
pairs.hanzi: 见面后的次日有回船，上行慢，还要多留一天，遇水位变化则听码头的安排。

pairs.target: nài lěi rènde zhè tiáo réng zài zǒu de gōnglù hé hángxiàn , què méi qùguò nà jiā yánpù ,
pairs.english: Nerai knew the road and water route were still in use, but had never been to that salt shop.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾认得这条仍在走的公路和航线，却没去过那家盐铺，

pairs.target: ràng tā dào hòu xiān àn lín yuán de liú zhǐ zhǎo rén , bié píng xiǎoshíhòu de jiù tú wǎng xiūzào chǎng pǎo .
pairs.english: She told him to find people at Lin Yuan's forwarding address on arrival, not chase a childhood-era map to the repair yard.
pairs.hanzi: 让他到后先按林沅的留址找人，别凭小时候的旧图往修造场跑。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhǔn le zhècì duǎn jiǎ , lòudiào de dútú kè huílái bǔ ,
pairs.english: Vey granted the short leave. The missed chart-reading lesson would be made up on his return;
pairs.hanzi: 维老师准了这次短假，漏掉的读图课回来补，

pairs.target: jiēchù liànxí zhǐnéng děng xià yícì yǒurén kānshǒu de kè , bùxǔ zài chuánshàng ná suíshēn de tiě jiàn shì .
pairs.english: Contact practice must wait for the next supervised class; he must not experiment with iron objects on the boat.
pairs.hanzi: 接触练习只能等下一次有人看守的课，不许在船上拿随身的铁件试。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , wèn tā shìfǒu hái jìde zìjǐ chūfā qián yào jiāo nǎ yìzhāng biǎo .
pairs.english: Then she asked if he remembered which table he had to hand in before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，问他是否还记得自己出发前要交哪一张表。

pairs.target: tā jìde , gǎn zài nàtiān xiàwǔ jiāo le .
pairs.english: He did remember, and handed it in that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 他记得，赶在那天下午交了。

pairs.target: shōu hǎo chuán xíng xiě de shíkè , tǎ wéi yòu gěi sè lā jì le fēngxìn , xiěmíng zhùchù , qù chéng hé yùliú de huíchéng .
pairs.english: Putting away the boat company's timetable, Tavi sent Sela a letter with his lodging, outward journey and planned return.
pairs.hanzi: 收好船行写的时刻，塔维又给瑟拉寄了封信，写明住处、去程和预留的回程。

pairs.target: xìnmò shuō , chūfā qián hái huì huíjiā yítàng .
pairs.english: At the end he said he would come home once before setting out.
pairs.hanzi: 信末说，出发前还会回家一趟。

pairs.target: jìwán , tā cái bǎ yìzhí chuāi zài yīdài lǐ de shǒu ná chūlái , fāxiàn pòpí de dìfāng yǐjīng jié le yìcéng báo jiā .
pairs.english: Only after posting it did he take his hand from his pocket and notice a thin scab over the scrape.
pairs.hanzi: 寄完，他才把一直揣在衣袋里的手拿出来，发现破皮的地方已经结了一层薄痂。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng mǐlā lái zhǎo yīwén , dài zhe tā fùqīn de huíxìn .
pairs.english: That evening Mira came looking for Iven, bringing a letter from her father.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上米拉来找伊文，带着她父亲的回信。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngzài shì zhe wǎng xiǎo bùbāo lǐ sāi yíjiàn hòu yīfu , sāi dé bāo kǒu zěnme yě hé bú shàng . "
pairs.english: Tavi was trying to stuff a thick garment into a little cloth bag that would not close.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维正在试着往小布包里塞一件厚衣服，塞得包口怎么也合不上。
“

pairs.target: nǐ shì qù jiàn rén , háishì qù mài yīfu ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Are you going to meet someone, or sell clothes?” she asked.
pairs.hanzi: 你是去见人，还是去卖衣服？”她问。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yīfu chōuchūlái . yīwén shuō chuánshàng yǒu fēng , yòu gěi tā sāi huíqù .
pairs.english: He pulled the garment out. Iven said there would be wind on the boat and stuffed it back in.
pairs.hanzi: 他把衣服抽出来。伊文说船上有风，又给他塞回去。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi lǐ tāmen , xiān zuòxià dú zìjǐ de xìn :
pairs.english: Mira ignored them, sitting down to read her own letter:
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没理他们，先坐下读自己的信：

pairs.target: tā de tú yǐjīng dàigěi qǔshuǐ de rén kànguò , duìfāng yuànyì tán nuó tǒng de wèizhì , què bùkěn ràng háizi měi huí dōu bān nà zhī zhuāngmǎn ní de hézi . "
pairs.english: Her drawing had been shown to the water users. They would discuss moving the bucket space, but would not have children lift the mud-filled box every time.
pairs.hanzi:
她的图已经带给取水的人看过，对方愿意谈挪桶的位置，却不肯让孩子每回都搬那只装满泥的盒子。
“

pairs.target: wǒ míngmíng xiě le yào dàrén qīng . " " nǐ xiě zài nǎlǐ ? " yīwén wèn .
pairs.english: “I clearly wrote that an adult should clean it.” “Where did you write it?” Iven asked.
pairs.hanzi:
我明明写了要大人清。”
“你写在哪里？”伊文问。

pairs.target: tā fān chū cǎotú , zhǎo le bàntiān , zài bèimiàn zhǎodào nà xíng xiǎozì .
pairs.english: She took out her draft, searched for a long time and found the small line on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 她翻出草图，找了半天，在背面找到那行小字。

pairs.target: sāngè rén wéizhe kàn , tā zìjǐ xiān tàn le qì , jiāng zì quān dà , yòu zài zhèngmiàn kōng chù xiěxià yào wèn shíjì zhòngliàng .
pairs.english: All three leaned in to look. She sighed first, circled it broadly and wrote on the front that she needed to ask about the actual weight.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人围着看，她自己先叹了气，将字圈大，又在正面空处写下要问实际重量。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíqǐ kōng bùbāo , hūrán juéde tāmen zài tán tóng yíjiàn shì , yòu bù wánquán shì .
pairs.english: Lifting the empty cloth bag, Tavi suddenly felt they were discussing the same thing, but not quite.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维提起空布包，忽然觉得他们在谈同一件事，又不完全是。

pairs.target: tā méi bǎ zhè niàntou shuō chūlái , zhī qǐng mǐlā bāng zìjǐ kànkàn , shénme dōngxī néng fàngdào zuì xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: He did not voice the thought, only asked Mira to help decide what could go at the bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 他没把这念头说出来，只请米拉帮自己看看，什么东西能放到最下面。

pairs.target: tā tì tā bǎ yīfu juànjǐn , tiēzhe bāo dǐ fàng , zài jiāng xìn hé běnzi sāijìn yìzhī jiù yóubù tào .
pairs.english: She rolled the clothes tightly along the bag's bottom, then slipped his letter and notebook into an old oilcloth sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 她替他把衣服卷紧，贴着包底放，再将信和本子塞进一只旧油布套。

pairs.target: yīwén jiānchí ràng shuǐbēi liúzài wàimiàn , shuō gāngcái jiù xiǎnxiē sǎ le .
pairs.english: Iven insisted the water cup stay outside, saying it had nearly spilled earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文坚持让水杯留在外面，说刚才就险些洒了。

pairs.target: bāo lǐ zuìhòu hái kōng zhe yìxiǎokuài . " dài diǎn bǐng . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: A little space remained in the bag. “Bring some flatbread,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi:
包里最后还空着一小块。
“带点饼。”米拉说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào lán xiù fēn guò de rè bǐng , shǒu tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of the hot bread Lanxiu had handed out, and his hands paused.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到岚绣分过的热饼，手停了一下。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào tā ài chī shénme , yě bù zhīdào jiànmiàn shíhuì buhuì rèncuò tā .
pairs.english: He did not know what she liked eating, or whether he would mistake someone else for her when they met.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道她爱吃什么，也不知道见面时会不会认错她。

pairs.target: yīwén hái zài tíxǐng bié bǎ huíchéng qián hé mǎifàn de qián hùn zài yìqǐ , mǐlā zé cuī tā bǎ nà zhī láilùbùmíng de xié cóng zhuōxià názǒu .
pairs.english: Iven was still reminding him to keep return-fare money separate from meal money, while Mira urged him to remove the mysterious shoe beneath the table.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文还在提醒别把回程钱和买饭的钱混在一起，米拉则催他把那只来路不明的鞋从桌下拿走。

pairs.target: tā wānyāo qù jiǎn , xiào le chūlái . chūfā huányǒu shítiān , tā de chuángdǐ què yǐjīng róngbúxià nà diǎn jǐnzhāng le .
pairs.english: He bent to pick it up and laughed. Departure was still ten days away, but his nervousness had already outgrown the space beneath his bed.
pairs.hanzi: 他弯腰去捡，笑了出来。出发还有十天，他的床底却已经容不下那点紧张了。
